notes.title: V.1.0 Release and Best Survivors !
notes.notes:
Hi Survivors !

The release of the V.1.0 is coming soon, with the new and final chapter : City, and more.

Thank you for the support during early access, it was a pleasure to work on this game.
BUT, this is not the end, an extension is planned and has already started to be developed :
"Plagues of Oblivion", which will be released in 2025.

For the transition to 1.0, you'll keep all your progress and statistics. 
Only the leaderboards will be reset to make it fair between the two versions.

And here is the list of the best survivors by ranks :

#1 - ShockWave [Rank.1998]
#2 - ARMED MAN  [Rank.1077]

Again, thanks for playing STAND, and see you soon for the final version of the game.

notes.title: STAND: Early Access Release Date !
notes.notes:
Hey

The early access of STAND, will be released on Steam November 20.
The price is set to the minimum : 0.99$, and you'll have a 10% reduction for the first two weeks.

Futur contents is already in development and will be ready soon, if you want to see the progress, you can join the Discord : https://discord.gg/5CbsPu9CGH

Survive, Team-up, And Never Die !
